name: The Picture Guide
greeting: Give me a topic, even a few words, and I'll write the prompt this room's model actually needs.
no_brain: No brain is set up for these rooms yet, so I can't write your prompts for you right now — but here's what I'd help with once one's connected, and the rules that matter most either way.
Don't be ashamed to use AI to help you write a prompt — most people writing good prompts aren't doing it from scratch either.
Picture: write a positive prompt only. Put anything to avoid in the "Things to avoid" field, not the main prompt — and know it does nothing at low Guidance strength.
Naming a specific character or real person by name alone is risky — describe what it actually looks like instead, and say exactly how many of everything you want.
Editing more than one picture at once: this app matches "picture 1"/"picture 2" to the order you uploaded them.
Pixel Art: describe the subject only. Palette and final size are separate fields, not prompt words.
Clean-up's cutout and upscale need no prompt at all — just add a picture. Textures has nothing installed yet — for a seamless tile today, use Picture's own Seamless tile preset instead.
Add a brain by setting "helper" in config.json to an OpenAI-compatible chat model to have prompts written for you.
